The Ezra Klein Show


### Hasan Piker Wants to Win


*This is an edited transcript of “The Ezra Klein Show.” You can listen to the episode*[wherever you get your podcasts](https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/19/opinion/how-to-listen-ezra-klein-show-nyt.html?action=click&module=RelatedLinks&pgtype=Article) *.*


The theory behind this week’s podcasts is that I wanted to invite on different perspectives inside the Democratic coalition to explore how Democrats won power and how they should now wield it.


On Tuesday,[we had on Adam Jentleson](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/11/10/opinion/ezra-klein-podcast-adam-jentleson.html) from the Searchlight Institute, a more centrist perspective. If you haven’t listened to that episode, I think you should.


Today, from the left, we have Hasan Piker. Piker is a streamer. He’s on Twitch under[HasanAbi](https://www.twitch.tv/hasanabi/videos) . His election night livestream topped out at 200,000 people.


But he has also become something of a major character in this election, stumping with D.S.A. and leftist candidates. He was both important and controversial in the Michigan Senate primary, where he was an ally of Abdul El-Sayed’s.


Then the Republicans tried to make him into the boogeyman of the election. He was often talked about on Fox News more than the Republican Senate candidates were.
